description: What an authoring role passes to the roles that run after it. Both keys are required. An empty array is a real answer meaning nothing here is worth another role a turn, and is not the same as the step never having run at all.

testingNotes.description: For the Tester. Behaviour that a test written to distrust this change should cover — not a description of what was built. Empty when the change genuinely warrants no new coverage.

area.description: The behaviour or flow to cover, named in reader-facing terms rather than as a file path.

why.description: What could break here and stay invisible to lint, typecheck and build. A note with no plausible silent failure behind it is not worth a test.

docsCandidates.description: For the Writer. Things that cost you time to work out and would cost the next reader the same. A proposal, never an instruction — the Writer decides what earns a place. Empty when nothing cost you time.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the document that should carry it. A free string on purpose: these roles are portable and must not encode the layout of any one repository.

note.description: What the document should say, stated as the fact itself rather than as a topic to write about.

why.description: The concrete cost you paid for not knowing it. This is the field that decides whether the note survives; with no real cost behind it, it usually should not.
